hypotheses.statement: Meaning-fixed LLM title slots break at 2024: pooled post OR >= 2; control pairs post OR in [0.67, 1.5]; slot-minus-control log OR > 0 (stacked post x LLM-slot, CT4 parameter).
hypotheses.model: logit y ~ slot FE + slot x (t-2023) + post + llm_topic, 2018-26, CRV by topic100; frozen V2 inventory; primary opener rule (after an optional NAME lead)
hypotheses.p_note: intersection-union: max of the one-sided p for pooled post > 0 and stacked interaction > 0

hypotheses.statement: From 2025 to 2026 the R24 title rate falls within area in >= 10 of 16 large areas and R26 rises in >= 12 of 16; falsified if fewer than 9 of 16 move as predicted.

large_areas: alignment, fairness, safety, privacy, and societal considerations
applications to computer vision, audio, language, and other modalities
applications to physical sciences (physics, chemistry, biology, etc.)
foundation or frontier models, including LLMs
learning on graphs and other geometries & topologies
learning on time series and dynamical systems
other topics in machine learning (i.e., none of the above)
transfer learning, meta learning, and lifelong learning
unsupervised, self-supervised, semi-supervised, and supervised representation learning

area_imputation_2023.method: multinomial logistic regression (C=1) on bge-small-en-v1.5 abstract embeddings, trained on 2025 papers (area_h, 21 areas)
area_imputation_2023.note: 2024 true labels lack 'foundation or frontier models' and 'time series' (2025+ only), so the 2024 accuracy is a pessimistic transfer check

hypotheses.p_note: intersection-union: max of the two one-sided sign tests

hypotheses.statement: 2025-26, logit with year FE, topic100 FE, log authors, llm_topic, log title length: OR(F24 -> R24 in title) > OR(F26 -> R24 in title). Falsified if the ratio is <= 1.
2024-26 within topic100 x year: OR(F -> LLM slot variant | slot filled) >= 1.5 x OR(F -> NAME) (same papers; two LPMs, seemingly-unrelated cluster bootstrap). Falsified if OR_slot <= OR_NAME.
hypotheses.p_note: bootstrap share of draws with OR_slot / OR_NAME <= 1 (1,000 draws)

hypotheses.statement: Exploratory, bounded: U* = (p_F0,post - p_pre) / (p_F1,post - p_pre) in a pooled-slot analysis; 'second-hand diffusion' is claimed only if U* > 0.8, otherwise unresolved.

deviations: Slot inventory frozen after V2: exploit/unlocking, exploit/enabling and reveal/decoding dropped (V2 sense precision < 0.85); a dropped word makes the slot 'not filled'. Borderline words (unleashing, harnessing, boosting) kept and tested by leave-one-variant-out and the unweighted-rule inventory.

Primary opener rule = PLAN text (opener after an optional NAME lead), not the pilot's any-colon-lead rule; the pilot-like rule is a robustness row. Hence n = 1,922 slot titles (2018+) vs the pilot's 2,362.

H3a randomization inference over break years and a year-level REML meta-regression (group-year shocks) were added (study convention, PLAN section 0); an event study of year deviations from 2018-22 slot trends was added after the break scan showed a comparable stacked OR at 2023.

H3b: primary_area does not exist before 2024, so 2023 areas were imputed with a classifier on bge abstract embeddings trained on 2025 labels; 2023 enters only the heat map and the 2023-26 Poisson model, never the 2025-vs-2026 test. Large areas follow the pilot rule (>= 500 titles in 2025+2026).
H3b is tested on the R24/R26 family rates (titles with any family word); the pilot numbers in the PLAN were for single words (enhanc*, unified). Single-word results are reported as robustness.
H3c uses the frozen v2 lexicons (RARE21 scout list; R24 stems), which differ from the vintage pilot's 19-term regex and -ing forms; the pilot lexicons are rerun as a reconciliation row.

H3d: LPM coefficients are converted to implied ORs at the F = 0 mean of each outcome; logit and conditional-logit ORs are reported as robustness. The NAME OR is estimated on the same slot-filled papers (PLAN: 'two LPMs on the same papers'); the population NAME OR is also reported.
H3e: post = 2024-25 and p_pre = 2022-23 fixed before estimation (pilot baseline); pooled over slots with common post weights. F1 contamination correction U*(1 - c) added as a sensitivity.

Adversarial-pass additions (not in the PLAN): control-pair leave-one-out rows (controls without via/using, novel/new, towards/toward) and event-study rows for controls without via; the stacked contrast without via/using is 1.41 [0.74, 2.68] under the PLAN level-shift model but 6.39 [1.68, 24.3] in 2024 under the event study with 2018-22 trends.
Camera-ready audit: pairs from cache/arxiv_audit.jsonl plus the enlargement file as present at run time (the enlargement job is still running; the line count is frozen in slots_results.json).
